Rank Math PRO downloads carried persistent WordPress backdoors

Target: Rank Math PRO
Date: 2026-10-15 to 2026-10-16
Target Kind: application
Language: PHP
Impact: backdoor, credential_theft
Phase: distribution

Synopsis

Some Rank Math PRO 3.0.123 downloads and updates contained malware during an eleven-hour window. Activation could install backdoors that recreated themselves on later page visits.
